course.name: 2-Day Basic Certificate in Dental Assisting
course.overview: A practical two-day course covering dental instruments and materials, infection control, and how to anticipate a dentist's needs during procedures.
course.no_intakes_message: Our upcoming course dates are being updated. Please leave your contact details, and our team will confirm the available dates with you.

skillsfuture.guidance: Participants may use basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits and must check their own available balance and submit their own claim. Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used for this course.

utap.support: 50% of the unfunded course fee, up to S$250 per year or S$500 per year for members aged 40 and above
rules: The participant must pay the course fee upfront.
The participant must attend both training days.
The claim must be submitted within six months after course completion.
Proof of payment and proof of completion are required.
UTAP and SkillsFuture Credits cannot be combined for the same course fee.

course.minimum_qualification: GCE N Levels are preferred. Applicants without GCE N Levels may be considered if they have basic English reading and writing skills because the assessment is conducted in English.
course.job_opportunities: Suitable candidates may be considered for job opportunities after the course, subject to Q&M's normal selection and interview process. A job is not guaranteed.

required_information: full name as shown on NRIC
payment_options: basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits with any remainder through PayNow
UTAP reimbursement after upfront payment and course completion

faqs.answer: The 2-Day Basic Certificate in Dental Assisting is a practical course covering dental instruments and materials, infection control, and anticipating a dentist's needs during procedures.
The full course fee is S$600 nett.
Training runs over two consecutive days, from 9:30am to 5:30pm each day.
The supplied course information lists the venue as Q&M HQ at Clementi Loop.
Use the configured intake list. If it is empty, use the no_intakes_message exactly and do not invent a date.
Basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits are accepted. Participants must check their own balance and submit their own claim.
Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used for this course.

Eligible NTUC Union members may claim 50% of the unfunded course fee, subject to the annual cap. They must pay upfront, attend both days, and claim within six months after completion. UTAP cannot be combined with SkillsFuture Credits.
GCE N Levels are preferred. Applicants with basic English reading and writing skills may still be considered because the assessment is conducted in English.
Suitable candidates may be considered for job opportunities after the course, subject to the normal selection and interview process. A job is not guaranteed.
The enrollment collects the selected intake when available, identity and contact details, payment preference, and the SkillsFuture and PayNow amounts before showing a final confirmation summary.
